notes.title: New Adventure ahead!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H_pcu2vQNHc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Adventurer,

We at rokaplay have committed ourselves to the [url=https://www.rokaplay.com/mission-statement][b]mission[/b][/url] to develop wholesome games and therefore it's time to pack your backpack and set off on a new adventure!

🎉We present a heart project directly from the deep mines of the rokaplay team coming to Kickstarter!🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/60b799939ae8ec6c6d0da62762eb6109ffaac46f.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]About Beasties - A community driven Monster trainer game[/h3][/b]
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

[url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] will start rolling on May the 18th and you are invited to join this special event, follow us into this new adventure!
For us, there could be no better travel companions than you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33933433/4fdf0983f0ad6b6445c27c0508dab68090444ec0.jpg[/img]
Here our first [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/DcHLpOh][b]Imgur post[/b][/url] for our upcoming game Beasties: "Behind the Scene: We spent 4 month to develope our own World-Editor, here is why!" 

Besides Super Dungeon Maker, Beasties is the second game we have announced this year. If you love wholesome games as much as we do, follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/][b]Steam[/b][/url]  or on [url=https://discord.gg/rokaplay][b]Discord[/b][/url] to never miss another adventure with us.

[url=https://linktr.ee/rokaplay][b]Follow us on Social Media[/b][/url]
Cheers and stay safe! 
Your team at rokaplay

notes.title: Discover the secrets of the Forgotten Land on june 25!
notes.content:
[i][h1]A clue leads you on a journey to a mysterious place..[/h1][/i]

[h1]The Forgotten Land will be released on June 25![/h1]

The Forgotten Land is an exciting turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a dark fantasy setting. Set up a sheltering camp, improve your heroes' abilities and unlock tactical bonuses.

[b]Show your combat skills! [/b]
In turn-based battles you have to outwit your opponents' tactics, thwart their chances for counterattacks and cleverly use the special powers of your team.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28675879/9c9fcab605dd4803b5c7628b048389e951a4b460.png[/img]


[b]Level up to new strenghts! [/b]
Grow along your journey.
Develop your team and improve your heroes' individual abilities!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28675879/dee3e54f4d34c3bd79801310b84c242b4484bb5d.png[/img]


[h1]Wishlist the Forgotten Land now![/h1]
And get notified when you can start your journey!

notes.title: Last Resort Island - TofuCalypse | Coming out June 28
notes.content:
As a castaway you strand on a remote island. Sounds like a romantic adventure in perfect loneliness - but not in this game! After all, that island is literally the last resort of the fleeing masses.

[b]Build your settlement, solve all side quest, strategy is your key, win the Solitaire championship, defeat the flocks of mindless zombies with unique fight mechanics, eat less tofu, 100% glutenfree![/b]

[u]Grab our game with 30% discount or put it on your wishlist![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/820910/Last_Resort_Island/

Features:
[list]
[*] Fun story full of whacky slapstick humour
[*] Unique fight mechanics
[*] Hunt for exiting and creative achievements
[*] Create your own survival paradise
[*] Different types of mindless zombies
[*] 96 hand-made levels full of intriguing gameplay
[*] Build a resort for the islanders: town hall, sugar factory, candy manufacture etc.
[*] Face challenging side quests
[*] Master many different adventures
[*] Win the Solitaire championship
[*] Use Power Stones and Power Cards 
[/list]

[spoiler] >Like< our new steam publisher page and get some hot underwear pictures from the devs :D [/spoiler]
